items.title: Trojan Crosswalk 340 Treadmill
items.description:
Trojan Crosswalk 340 Treadmill. It has been well maintained, carefully looked after, and is in excellent condition. 

It features quick-select speed controls, allowing you to adjust your workout with ease, as well as multiple incline levels to increase the intensity of your training. The built-in Body Fat Index programmes help you monitor your fitness progress, while the Crosswalk handlebars provide an upper-body workout in addition to walking or running.

When not in use, the treadmill folds up neatly to save space and is fitted with transport wheels, making it easy to move and store
